ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Promoters of ACC Limited, Holderind Investments and Endeavour Trade and Investment, have created an "other covenant in the nature of encumbrance" on 6.64% of ACCL's total share capital (11.72% of their promoter holding) to secure new debt facilities up to USD 1.375 billion for refinancing purposes. A significant red flag is the reported security cover ratio of 0.05, which implies the collateralized shares' value is only 5% of the debt, indicating severe under-collateralization or a critical reporting error.
